CodeMirror 5 — vendored source record
=====================================

WHAT IS HERE, AND WHY IT IS VENDORED
------------------------------------
The Settings page's Expert Mode editor (see `services/webservice/static/settings-yaml.js`
and `services/webservice/templates/settings.html`) uses CodeMirror 5 for two things and
two things only: YAML SYNTAX HIGHLIGHTING while the operator types, and the line-oriented
marking of the lines a validation refusal names.

It is VENDORED ON PURPOSE — the console must work with NO NETWORK. No CDN is referenced
by any page or script; the files below are served from the shell's own `/static` area
(`/static/vendor/codemirror/...`), exactly like the language flags under
`services/webservice/static/flags/`. The flag SVGs set that precedent; this is its second
instance. A page that loaded the editor from a CDN would be a page the console cannot use
offline.

FILES
-----
  codemirror.min.js        CodeMirror 5 core                 (lib/codemirror.js)
  codemirror.min.css       CodeMirror 5 default stylesheet  (lib/codemirror.css)
  mode/yaml.min.js         the YAML mode                    (mode/yaml/yaml.js)
  LICENSE                  the upstream MIT licence, verbatim

The shell's own dark theme overrides the default stylesheet's colours (see the
`CodeMirror` rules at the foot of `services/webservice/static/shell.css`); the vendored
CSS is left BYTE-FOR-BYTE as upstream shipped it, so an upgrade is a plain file swap.

VERSION AND PROVENANCE
----------------------
  version:  5.65.16
  source:   https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/codemirror/5.65.16/codemirror.min.js
            https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/codemirror/5.65.16/codemirror.min.css
            https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/codemirror/5.65.16/mode/yaml/yaml.min.js
  licence:  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/codemirror/codemirror5/5.65.16/LICENSE
